::: {#exm-deep-learning}

#### AlexNet

AlexNet, a network for sorting photographs into 1000 classes,
has eight layers with weights:
five convolutional layers, then three fully connected ones.
Its 60 million parameters were learned from 1.2 million labelled images,
and the 96 filters of its first layer learned on their own
to respond to edges at different angles and to patches of colour
[@krizhevsky2012imagenet].
Nobody designed those [features](https://morrison-lab.github.io/lds/chapters/course-overview.html#def-feature); training found them.

:::
